node.title: Nested products retain all joint rank-one and rank-two anchors
node.statement: Nested product W=(V,0)+(0,B), B subset V, shared s and codimension c, has two all-coordinate child types: nonroots drop pair rank2 and preserve c; B-roots drop pair rank1 and reduce c by1. Shared dimension drops1 and primitive degree excess kappa=D-(s-1) cannot increase in either case. At most kappa+c coordinates are roots. All-coordinate original-weight incidence and affine-ratio endpoint bounds give a finite state recurrence, with whole-constant scalar LIST terminals and one-pair ownership. No generic-coordinate exclusion, new source resource or row payment is assumed.
